description: WebMCP Business Rules & Prompt Catalog Sample for Multi-Country Address Book

rules.name: South Africa Localization (ZA)
rules.systemContext: ZA business rules: requires a 13-digit South African ID and UIF/PAYE withholding calculation. 4-digit postal code.
suggestedPrompts: Create a contact for South Africa with a 13-digit ID
Validate a South African address and postal code

rules.name: Spain Localization (ES)
rules.systemContext: ES business rules: requires a valid DNI/NIE/NIF document and a 5-digit Spanish postal code (CP).
suggestedPrompts: Create a contact for Spain with a valid DNI/NIF
Validate an address and postal code in Spain

rules.name: Canada Localization (CA)
rules.systemContext: CA business rules: requires a Social Insurance Number (9-digit SIN), an alphanumeric postal code (A1A 1A1), and GST/HST tax.
suggestedPrompts: Create a contact for Canada with a SIN and GST/HST
Validate a Canadian postal code format (A1A 1A1)
